Covers the whole chapter in the book's order: introduction (functional groups), 25.1 synthesis, retrosynthesis and its terminology, functional group interconversion, 25.2 ethyl acetate, aniline and acetophenone, 25.3 paracetamol and aspirin, 25.4 AI in drug designing (halicin) and the two Interesting Information boxes. Book corrections followed: ethyl acetate SE = acetic acid + ethanol; paracetamol Step IV disconnects 4-nitrophenol into HO–C₆H₄⁻ + NO₂⁺ with SE phenol + nitric acid; pathogens (not antibiotics) become resistant; halicin rings contain sulfur.
